dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Data are based on information in a US-EPA LCA study about LCD and CRT production. The data represent an estimated LCD glass production – based on data for the CRT production. No major updates were found from the available public literature except for reduced energy intensity according to Cantini te al 2022. Energy consumption is also represented as global LCD glass production. 2023 updates are related to global material input and new background datasets at the inventory level.; UUID: c9b36b13-2358-3a41-884b-d67bcabae555

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Estimation based on current production technologies for the CRT glass production.

# Included processes
This module includes the following production steps: preparation and sorting of cullet, melting, forming of LCD flat glass parts, cooling down and palletisting until the glass parts are ready for the next process step. Included are as well direct emissions to air, waste water, and waste. Infrastructure and transport efforts of the input materials are estimated based on packaging glass production.
